ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. The graduate tuition rate for this section is $309 per credit hour; the undergrad tuition rate is $277 per credit hour. All students in this section will also be assessed a $45 per credit hour administration fee. These assessments are not included in campus range assessments.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $309.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $277.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $45.00 per Bill Hour.
